title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first week in MDS was quite the experience. Orientation was exciting but tiring, especially because of my commute. My first week of classes was honestly brutal. Since I don’t have a background in data science, learning all the new software while keeping up with all the homework every week has been a huge adjustment.
Now I am feeling very overwhelmed, especially with midterms already coming up. Waking up for my 8am classes has also been a challenge. However, even though it has been stressful, I have really enjoyed the grind and the experience so far.
I’m slowly getting more comfortable with everything and looking forward to seeing how much I can improve, but midterm week is coming up next.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
I became interested in Data Science toward the end of my bachelor’s degree. I have always enjoyed working with numbers, analyzing problems, and finding solutions that support better decision-making. During my work as a Receiver, I gained experience with data entry, inventory tracking, and records management. However, this made me realize that I wanted to do more than simply manage data, and I wanted to use data to analyze problems and support decision-making. Thus, I enrolled in the UBC MDS program, where I hope to develop the technical skills needed for a career in data analysis. The accelerated 10-month format also fits well with my goal of transitioning into the field quickly.

I am an avid fan of football, especially the English Premier League. My favorite team is Chelsea FC. I am also a huge foodie, and I enjoy exploring various restaurants in Vancouver with diverse cuisines. My favorite food is Donair.
